summary: Tom Tiffany co-introduced the GAZA Act to block new US visas and parole for Palestinian Authority passport holders, labeling them "bad actors" and "radicals," and co-authored an editorial calling the permanent defeat of Hamas a moral imperative. He voted Yea on H.R. 6090, which directs use of the IHRA definition in Title VI education-discrimination enforcement, and remained supportive of Israel into March 2024 despite ceasefire calls. Vote for Peace rated him Opposed for the general election.
